summary: Compassionate appointment claims by heirs of deceased municipal employees; municipal employees not deemed state government employees but covered by existing circulars (301-Emp., 302-Emp., 303-Emp.); high court correctly held subsistence of applicable schemes; delay in processing attributed to authorities, not applicants; no substituted scheme formulated despite 142-Emp. guidance; appeals dismissed with directions to process applications under extant circulars.
legal_provisions_cited: West Bengal Regulation of Recruitment in State Government Establishments and Establishments of Public Undertakings, Statutory Bodies, Government Companies and Local Authorities Act, 1999 (West Bengal Act XIV of 1999)
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; High Court judgment upheld; municipal authorities directed to consider applications under Circular Nos. 301-Emp., 302-Emp., and 303-Emp.
